observations: Photo 0 shows a black Nikon DSLR with “Nikon” on the prism and “D610” on the front, body cap mounted, visible scuffs on the grip and body.
Photo 1 shows the same camera from a similar angle with the same visible wear and a white cable at the lower left edge.
Photo 2 shows the top and rear of the same camera, including the LCD panel, mode dial, hot shoe, and more body scuffing.
No lens, battery, charger, or box is visible in any photo.

claims.claim: Used Nikon D610 in good condition
claims.evidence: Photos show the exterior but cannot confirm function or overall condition.

claims.claim: May show sign of cosmetic wears
claims.evidence: Photos 0-2 show visible scuffs and wear on the camera body and grip.
No battery or charger is visible in any photo.
Photos 0 and 1 clearly show “Nikon” branding and “D610” model marking.

risks.proof: Photo of the original battery and charger together.
